release_notes:
v1.0.10+16 - Continuous Two-Way Live Masterclass & Connection Telemetry HUD
- Two-way camera & microphone live on classroom entry (student broadcast online continuously)
- Real-time Connection Telemetry HUD pill (latency ping, 2/2 participant count, and live indicators)
- Tap-to-open Agora Connection Inspector modal for latency, bitrates, audio engine, and token security
- Normalized studio room channels to guarantee teacher & student land in the exact same Agora room
